name: OpenVibe.Codes

site.name: Codes
site.what: The developer portal: API and SDK docs, the service and capability registry, event schemas, credentials, playgrounds and mod publishing.

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP; it checks nothing else (the database and dependencies are what ready checks)

resumes.what: unsent events in the outbox table go to OpenVibe.Events once the relay starts (at least once; Events dedupes by event_id)

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart (30 s in host.example.json); manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies
blockers: the trust table was rebuilt once to the ADR-013 tier names (server/db.js maps the old values): a release from before it expects the old tier names

leases.none: no claims: one process owns codes.db (better-sqlite3, single writer)

notes: Port 4900, unit openvibe-codes.service, state /var/lib/openvibe-codes. The developer portal (ADR-014): projects, members, apps, credentials, grants and quotas are OWNED BY NETWORK and shown through Network's /api/v1/projects API with the signed-in person's own token; Codes stores none of them and never a secret. Codes owns only manifests, releases (+ append-only release_log), trust tiers (metadata) and playground run logs in its own SQLite. Consumes OpenVibe.Network (SSO with PKCE S256 as OAuth client codes, JWKS, the projects API, the registry, client-credentials) and publishes through OpenVibe.Events (events.event.publish). Playgrounds call Events and Media with the APP's own token only. Docs are generated at boot from the pinned openvibe-contracts and openvibe-sdk.
